/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const base = 'http://localhost:3100'
const pageCases = [
  ['/', 200, 'Welcome to My Blog'],
  ['/blog', 200, 'All Blog Posts'],
  ['/blog/1', 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/11', 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['/blog/9999', 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['/missing', 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
]
for (const [path, expectedStatus, expectedText] of pageCases) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path)
  const html = await response.text()
  assert.equal(response.status, expectedStatus, path)
  assert.ok(html.includes(expectedText), path)
  console.log("'`${response.status} ${path}: ${expectedText}`)
}
const apiCases = [
  ['"'GET', '/api/posts', undefined, 200],
  ['POST', '/api/posts', { title: 'New', content: 'Body' }, 201],
  ['POST', '/api/posts', { title: 'New' }, 400],
  ['GET', '/api/posts/5', undefined, 200],
  ['PUT', '/api/posts/5', { title: 'Edited' }, 200],
  ['DELETE', '/api/posts/5', undefined, 200],
  ['PATCH', '/api/posts/5', {}, 405],
]
for (const [method, path, body, expectedStatus] of apiCases) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path, {
    method,
    headers: body ? { 'content-type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  })
  assert.equal(response.status, expectedStatus, "'`${method} ${path}`)
  console.log(`${response.status} ${method} ${path}`)
}
EOF'
